personal_info.name: Priyanshu Choudhary
personal_info.headline: Full-Stack Developer building scalable web and mobile apps with React, Next.js, React Native, Node.js and TypeScript
personal_info.summary: Full-Stack Developer experienced in building scalable web and mobile applications with React.js, Next.js, React Native, Node.js, and TypeScript. Proficient in REST APIs, GraphQL, AWS SQS-based event-driven systems, SQL/NoSQL databases, Dockerized deployments, and CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions, with a strong focus on performance and reliability.
personal_info.tagline: Full-Stack Developer · React Native · GraphQL · Node.js · TypeScript

highlights: Led the migration of a production React Native rider app from REST to a typed GraphQL gateway, replacing 29 RTK Query modules with 71 typed Apollo Client v4 operations via GraphQL Codegen across 230+ files, eliminating 3,300 lines of hand-rolled REST plumbing

Architected the app's GraphQL networking layer as sole author: Apollo HttpLink chain, per-request auth link, and a refresh-then-logout error link backed by a single refreshToken mutation shared across GraphQL and legacy REST callers

Built the backend-driven rider onboarding funnel end-to-end: 11 screens (KYC, PAN/Aadhaar/DL/RC/insurance, employment, bank, nominee) with 9 React Hook Form + Yup validation hooks and a routing engine mapping 7 onboarding steps to 8 account states, making the server the source of truth for funnel position
Shipped in-app UPI/COD collection using Razorpay dynamic QR, implementing a 7-state payment hook with 3-second status polling, app-kill recovery, and idempotent payment reconciliation
Eliminated 28,000 lines of dead flow code across 108 files in a sequenced, verified refactor ending with a zero-dead-reference TypeScript pass
Diagnosed and fixed an Apollo cache-normalization bug causing riders to see the wrong delivery address and coordinates on manifest cards, resolved via a custom cache type policy

Authored the rider-gateway API contract (345-line integration guide + 160-line gap analysis) and drove 12 schema gaps to closure with the backend team, including address autofill, vendor search, and OCR document extraction
Led migration from Expo SDK 50 to SDK 53, resolving Android/iOS build blockers and stabilizing production releases

Built a scalable frontend profile management system used by 3,000+ users, reducing manual profile completion time by 40% by converting AI-parsed resume data into editable, structured profile sections with optimized state handling
Developed scalable Node.js RESTful APIs using Express.js and GraphQL supporting core user profile and application workflows
Designed and implemented auto scalable DynamoDB schemas, ensuring consistent profile initialization and reliable data access for 3,000+ authenticated users
Built event-driven backend systems using AWS SQS to enable asynchronous synchronization of user profile data from DynamoDB to analytics-focused downstream services
Monitored and reduced Firebase Crashlytics crash rate by 12%, addressing frequent Android navigation-related crashes

Owned end-to-end mobile delivery by implementing CI/CD pipelines with Expo EAS to automate builds and deployments to Google Play Internal Testing and Apple TestFlight, resolving 6+ Gradle and native dependency build issues
